title: READOUT: Secretary of the Treasury Scott Bessent's Meeting with Her Majesty Queen Maxima of the Netherlands and Minister of Finance Eelco Heinen of the Kingdom of the Netherlands
summary: U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent met with Dutch Queen Maxima and Finance Minister Eelco Heinen on April 19, 2026, to discuss global financial literacy initiatives. The meeting was framed around support for U.S. G20 priorities and acknowledgment of Dutch leadership on financial literacy topics. Queen Maxima was thanked for her role as UN Secretary-General's Special Advocate for Financial Health.
